surgeon-general-2023.name: U.S. Surgeon General advisory on loneliness and isolation
surgeon-general-2023.outcome: About half of U.S. adults say they have felt lonely; the advisory compares the health risk to smoking up to 15 cigarettes daily; Americans spent about 20 minutes a day in person with friends in 2020, down from 60 minutes nearly two decades earlier
surgeon-general-2023.locator: "up to 15 cigarettes daily"; "About half of U.S. adults"
surgeon-general-2023.limits: Associated Press report on the advisory, a secondary source; the advisory PDF on hhs.gov returned 403. The smoking comparison is about early-death risk across many studies, not a measured effect for one person.

jumbo-kletskassa.name: Chat checkouts (Kletskassa) at the Dutch supermarket chain Jumbo
jumbo-kletskassa.outcome: The first chat checkout opened in Vlijmen in 2019; in 2021 Jumbo planned chat checkouts in some 200 stores, with another 200 the following year, aimed at older shoppers in areas where loneliness is an issue
jumbo-kletskassa.locator: "Some 200 Jumbo supermarkets will be opening up tills"
jumbo-kletskassa.limits: News report based on Jumbo's own announcement from 2021; no independent evaluation of the effect on loneliness was found.

epley-commuters.name: Mistakenly Seeking Solitude, a study by Nicholas Epley and Juliana Schroeder
epley-commuters.outcome: Bus and train commuters in the Chicago area who were asked to talk with a stranger reported a significantly happier ride than those who kept to themselves; other commuters had predicted the opposite
epley-commuters.locator: "a significantly happier ride"; others "predicted the opposite"
epley-commuters.limits: Summary in the business school's own magazine; self-reported mood on a single commute, not a measure of loneliness over time.

hall-hours.name: How many hours it takes to make a friend, a study by Jeffrey Hall
hall-hours.outcome: Roughly 50 hours together to go from acquaintance to casual friend, 90 hours to become friends, and more than 200 hours to become good friends; time spent hanging out counts much more than time spent working together
hall-hours.locator: "Hours spent working together just don't count as much."
hall-hours.limits: University press release on two survey studies of people who had recently moved; the hour counts are estimates, and the ranges differ slightly between the two studies.

friendship-line.name: Friendship Line from the Institute on Aging
friendship-line.outcome: A 24/7 toll-free emotional support line at 888-670-1360 for adults 60 and older, adults with disabilities, and caregivers; it makes ongoing outreach calls to people who fill out its intake form
friendship-line.locator: "To receive outbound calls from the Friendship Line, fill out the intake form."
friendship-line.limits: Serves California only; the year is the date the page was checked, not the year the line started.

uk-strategy.name: England's first loneliness strategy and Minister for Loneliness
uk-strategy.outcome: Doctors in England were to be able to refer lonely patients to community activities and volunteer groups (social prescribing) by 2023; in a pilot in Liverpool, New Malden, and Whitby, postal workers checked on lonely people during their usual delivery rounds
uk-strategy.locator: "postal workers check up on lonely people as part of their usual delivery rounds"
uk-strategy.limits: Government announcement of plans, with no outcome data; whether the 2023 rollout was reached wasn't checked in this run.

nesterly.name: Nesterly home sharing
nesterly.outcome: Connects older people who have rooms to spare with younger, lower-income renters, who help out in exchange for lower rent; launched in 2016 in partnership with the city of Boston
nesterly.locator: "young people can help out in exchange for lower rent"
nesterly.limits: AARP feature from 2019; current cities, prices, and the size of the rent discount weren't checked.

front-porch-forum.name: Front Porch Forum
front-porch-forum.outcome: Moderated, real-name neighborhood forums available in all 251 Vermont towns, with nearly 60,000 households taking part; a new forum opens fully once 100 residents sign up
front-porch-forum.limits: Undated article from a Vermont rural development nonprofit, a secondary source; the household count is likely out of date. The year is the date checked.

timeleft.name: Timeleft dinners with strangers
timeleft.outcome: Every Wednesday the app groups six compatible strangers for dinner at a restaurant; operating in more than 200 cities; paid by a monthly fee
timeleft.limits: A magazine writer's first-person account, not a study; the price isn't stated, and city counts in other coverage differ. The year is the date checked.

parkrun-volunteers.name: Survey of parkrun volunteers
parkrun-volunteers.outcome: parkrun holds free, weekly, timed 5 km events; of 60,680 survey returns, 83.5% of people who only volunteered said it improved how much they felt part of a community, and 71.2% said it made them happier
parkrun-volunteers.locator: "free, weekly and timed"; "How much you feel part of a community"
parkrun-volunteers.limits: Self-reported survey of people already taking part, with no comparison group; it doesn't say how many events run in the United States.

mens-shed.name: Australian Men's Sheds
mens-shed.outcome: Community workshops where men build furniture, restore bicycles for a local school, and fix lawn mowers, at their own pace, usually with a space to sit, talk, and have a drink
mens-shed.locator: "an updated version of the shed in the backyard"
mens-shed.limits: The national association's own description; the page gives no count of sheds and no outcome data. The year is the date checked.

cohousing.name: Cohousing
cohousing.outcome: Private homes grouped around shared space and a common house, where residents regularly share meals; Muir Commons in Davis was the first U.S. cohousing community, in 1991, and more than 160 communities in 25 states have followed
cohousing.limits: Encyclopedia page, a secondary source; community counts may be dated. The national cohousing association's page returned 403.

big-lunch.name: The Big Lunch, run by the Eden Project
big-lunch.outcome: Neighbors share a meal together on the first weekend in June; some 6 million people take part each year; reducing loneliness is a stated aim
big-lunch.locator: "the UK's biggest annual get-together for neighbours"
big-lunch.limits: The organizer's own participation figure; no loneliness outcome is reported. The year is the date checked.

buy-nothing.name: Buy Nothing Project
buy-nothing.place: Bainbridge Island, WA, and Lansdowne, Pennsylvania
buy-nothing.outcome: More than 4.27 million members in about 6,800 local groups in 44 countries, where neighbors give, receive, lend, and borrow for free; in Lansdowne, Pennsylvania, neighbors on one block who met this way started their own group chat
buy-nothing.locator: "you may give, receive, lend, and borrow"
buy-nothing.limits: Local news feature; membership counts are the project's own figures.

absalon.name: Absalon communal dinners (fællesspisning)
absalon.outcome: Family-style dinners at long tables, where the host seats people who come alone beside friendly regulars; communal meals in the city usually cost between 30 and 100 Danish kroner
absalon.limits: City tourism board article, undated; prices may have changed. The year is the date checked.

chat-bench.name: Police chat benches
chat-bench.outcome: Avon and Somerset Police put signs on benches reading "Sit here if you don't mind someone stopping to say hello"; police said 17% of older people are in contact with family, friends, and neighbors less than once a week
chat-bench.locator: "Sit here if you don't mind someone stopping to say hello!"
chat-bench.limits: A good-news site reporting a police Facebook post; no outcome data.

san-mateo.name: San Mateo County loneliness public health emergency
san-mateo.outcome: The Board of Supervisors declared loneliness a public health emergency, the first U.S. county to do so, after a 2022 county survey found 45% of residents struggling with loneliness and isolation; the resolution set aside no money
san-mateo.locator: "45% of residents were struggling with loneliness and isolation"
san-mateo.limits: News report; the declaration funds nothing, and no results are known yet.

lifeline-988.name: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
lifeline-988.outcome: Call, text, or chat 988, free and confidential, 24/7/365; for emotional distress or simply wanting someone to talk to
lifeline-988.limits: A crisis and support line for a single conversation, not an ongoing friendship. The year is the date checked.

sandstrom-weak-ties.name: Weak ties and barista studies by Gillian Sandstrom and Elizabeth Dunn
sandstrom-weak-ties.outcome: Coffee shop customers who smiled, made eye contact, and chatted briefly with the barista reported more positive emotions and a greater sense of belonging than customers who kept it efficient; people were happier on days they talked with more acquaintances than usual
sandstrom-weak-ties.locator: "more positive emotions and a greater sense of belonging"
sandstrom-weak-ties.limits: University extension summary of two small studies, a secondary source; short-term mood, not loneliness over months.

liu-reaching-out.name: The Surprise of Reaching Out, a study by Peggy Liu and colleagues
liu-reaching-out.outcome: Across studies with more than 5,900 people, those who sent a short message or note to someone they hadn't talked with in a while underestimated how much it was appreciated; more surprising messages were appreciated more
liu-reaching-out.locator: "Appreciation tended to be greater when the reach-out was more surprising."
liu-reaching-out.limits: News summary of a journal article; the APA press release page loaded empty.

eldercare-locator.name: Eldercare Locator
eldercare-locator.outcome: A public service of the federal Administration for Community Living: call or text 1-800-677-1116, or enter a location online, to find local services for older adults and their families, including your Area Agency on Aging
eldercare-locator.locator: "a public service of the Administration for Community Living"
eldercare-locator.limits: For older adults and their families; the page doesn't list hours. The year is the date checked.

idealist-volunteer.name: Idealist volunteer search, which VolunteerMatch merged into in 2025
idealist-volunteer.outcome: Over 100,000 volunteer opportunities across 56 cause areas, searchable within a radius of 5 to 100 miles of home
